summary: For HA automation hub, set `automationhub_pg_host` and `automationhub_pg_port` to the database host and list it under `[database]`; list every hub node in `[automationhub]` instead of `localhost ansible_connection=local`. Afterwards check `USE_X_FORWARDED_PORT = True` and `USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST = True` in `/etc/pulp/settings.py`, and point `automationgateway_main_url` at the load balancer.
questions: How do I install highly available automation hub?
What is USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST in pulp settings?
Which URL should automationgateway_main_url be with a load balancer?

answer_card.title: HA automation hub inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationhub]
automationhub1.testing.ansible.com ansible_user=cloud-user
automationhub2.testing.ansible.com ansible_user=cloud-user
automationhub3.testing.ansible.com ansible_user=cloud-user

[database]
192.0.2.10

[all:vars]
automationhub_pg_host='192.0.2.10'
automationhub_pg_port=5432
automationgateway_main_url=https://<load balancer>
```
After install, each hub's `/etc/pulp/settings.py` should have `USE_X_FORWARDED_PORT = True` and `USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST = True`.
